Results.ReviewText:
This is my third Weber Grill and with the first two I was incredibly satisfied. But this Spirit has a critical design flaw. The grease tray is open/not protected so the first several times I grilled animals (raccoon, squirrel???) pulled out the tray and got grease all over my patio. Now I have to clean the tray every time I grill to avoid the issue. And yes, I have it covered with a Weber grill cover….

The cooking is great - as I always expect from Weber - but the design flaw for a $650 grill is inexcusable. How much would enclosing have cost??? Generously giving 2 stars, but now enjoy grilling significantly less than with my old Weber that’s now gone…..
Results.Title: Great grill if cook/store indoors….

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: The parts are precisely manufactured assembly is fairly easy. The grill's controls are convenient and ignition is reliable in all three. The grill's small size doesn't lend itself to zonal cooking, but cooking across the grill at all flame settings is very satisfactory.
Results.Title: Good value in a small grill

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: The Weber three burner design has been serving me well for years. The chicken has been outstanding. Lol. I went to a cheaper grill once, yes once. It never preformed, or had the quality of my first Weber, which lasted 20+ years. The quality has been consistent over the years as well. I prefer the two wheel design due to the lack of pavers or hard flat surfaces out here in the country. Another plus to this model is the folding shelf on one side which reduces the vertical profile. What can I say besides I'm glad to come back to Weber. Mike
Results.Title: The best I have ever used.

The warming grill tray that was included in the box is for a different model so I am waiting for a replacement.  Although there are 3 burners, it takes a long time for the grill to heat up.  I bought a Weber Sprit model about 15 years ago and got rid of it when I moved about 2 years ago.  It is sad to see how much the quality of the new model has suffered.  There are more plastic pieces and the metal parts are thinner.  I don't expect this grill to last so it will end up in a dump sooner rather than later.  Sad for the earth

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: It cooks well, and though not entirely evenly, at least more evenly than other grills I have owned. The stainless marks up too easily, but again, by comparison, even older Webers I've owned that had shelves of other materials have fallen apart, and one would assume these won't since they shouldn't rust or rot easily. The optional griddle I included gives me versatile cooking options, doing seafoods, vegetables, even the flatter meat cuts on it sears them all over instead of only grill lines, which is really nice. Now as long as it performs well at least twice as long as typical grills, since it costs twice as much, I should end up ahead of the game . . !
Results.Title: So far so good, ask me in a few years!

45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.


 This product requires assembly.
